tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read text with one-based inclusive start_line/end_line (omitted or zero: first/EOF) and optional explicit max_bytes. Full uncapped result is retained by the job.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file and parent directories. Existing files require overwrite:true unless append:true; append preserves existing bytes.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace exactly one literal old_text occurrence with new_text. Empty or ambiguous anchors fail without writing.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List immediate entries sorted by name; directories end in /.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search text with a Go regular expression. context_lines defaults to 0; matching path:line:text and context path-line-text use merged grep-style windows.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Start a fresh /bin/sh in a PTY; merged output and exit_code persist on disk. cwd applies only to this call, relative to Workspace. Delay bounds observation, not execution; a running report is a handle, not cancellation.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Wait for unseen output of a retained job, including a finished job. Never cancels work.

tools.name: send_input
tools.description: Submit a line to an interactive job (adds newline) and wait for unseen output.

tools.name: kill_job
tools.description: SIGKILL the process group, or mark a Go job killed (Go cannot stop its goroutine).

tools.name: tool_limits
tools.description: Set observation limits for the very next call, whichever tool it is; that call reports consumption.
